explicit_conventions: The source's point-fiber calibration display is interpreted as calibration on every measurable reported-probability event; no conditional-label version is selected on null prediction fibers.
Predictors are measurable, and a strategy accuracy is used only when its induced correctness indicator is integrable.
Lean totalizes C to all real profiles, while source-facing uses are restricted to predictor profiles in [0,1]^n and Definition 4's interior domain where applicable.
Named reliability, Proposition 7, and Proposition 9 results require a nonempty Fin n because the source uses an agent minimum and an existential k in [n].
The partition construction is proved for finite measurable cells only; a zero-mass cell is assigned prediction 0.
review_scope.source_model: Raw probability law on X x {0,1}, event-calibrated predictors, and actual joint-law classifier accuracies.
source_repairs_or_domain_clarifications: The S1 probability/interior construction uses the implicit 0 < epsilon < 1/2 domain, not only the printed upper bound.
The S2 mass denominator is repaired from the source's free-index q-odds display to the common sum over both p- and q-odds families.

llm_assumption_review.policy: Judge the three Assumptions.lean conventions independently: predictor measurability, event calibration rather than positive point fibers, and integrability of the strategy correctness indicator. They are model-definedness conditions, not hidden proof conclusions. Also record the totalization/nonempty-n/S1-positivity/finite-partition boundaries in the source map even when they are expressed by theorem binders rather than standalone assumptions.

llm_paper_coverage_review.policy: Use audit/paper_statement_map.json as a source-first inventory. Route each source definition, formula, proposition, lemma, theorem, and local repair through a current reviewed PaperInterface row by expanded semantic content. Do not infer coverage from matching names. Keep the user-approved finite-measurable zero-cell partition convention visible, and require the strict raw Proposition 7 and Proposition 9 mixture rows for the two final contradiction steps.

llm_source_record_review.policy: Run the code-backed recursive source-record audit against the current review rows and Assumptions.lean. Classify records and premises by expanded semantic content and exact source anchors. A conditional constructor may count only through its current checked_projection contract with exact source antecedents; names and free-form derivation text are not evidence.

llm_statement_review.policy: For every selected source claim, compare only its exact byte-pinned raw source-anchor bundle and Lean's expanded transparent `...Spec : Prop` target. The paired proof endpoint receives separate Lean-Meta proof credit; a name, paraphrase, wrapper, or prior aggregate receipt is not a semantic match. Review every retained paper-local prerequisite and every material library prerequisite before the dependent claim.

semantic_model_review.policy: For every reviewed row, compare the expanded source and Lean models before judging statement fidelity. The comparison must identify the raw joint-law carrier, predictor range and measurability, source probability endpoints, event calibration versus undefined null point fibers, strategy expectation definedness, totalized strategy domain, nonempty Fin n use, finite-measurable partition restriction, zero-mass-cell value, S1 positivity, and S2 normalizer. Each detected shape needs an exact source locator, expanded Lean evidence, and a checked bridge where required. Declaration names are routing only.

source_proof_fidelity_review.policy: The current schema-2 ledger separately records loss, point-fiber calibration, half-tie, mixture-index, finite-measurable partition, accidental-iff, S1-positivity, and S2-normalizer findings. Keep it synchronized with this surface before closeout. The event-calibration and finite-partition readings are user-approved conventions and must remain explicit rather than hidden in a theorem statement.
